name: Generate Swagger Specs for Workflows with Webhooks

parameters.content:
## Configure Webhooks

Key Notes:  For N8N 2.0> you need to add an environment variable to docker compose to allow file access:
    - N8N_RESTRICT_FILE_ACCESS_TO=/swagger-html  # Note - This is needed to write files in N8N 2.X

And you need to mount a directory that has RW permission in the container:
 - ./swagger-html:/swagger-html:rw

In order to support parameter labels you have to open the note sections of every webhook and add the following text

//@body field_name string description
//@query field_name string description
